DitherText.backdrop: The flat colour behind the text.
DitherText.direction: Gradient: the way it thins out, in degrees as in CSS (0 up, 90 right), from its dense side. 180 is solid at the top. Noise, dotted and hatched: the way it drifts.
DitherText.from: Tone at the dense and at the sparse end.
DitherText.to: Tone at the dense and at the sparse end.
DitherText.scale: Noise only: higher values give smaller blobs.
DitherText.ghost: Opacity of the ink between the dots, so textured letters keep their shape. A negative value takes the default.
DitherText.matrix: The dither pattern for gradient and noise.
